issues_resolved: Original synchronous model middleware required an asynchronous execution bridge.
Factory filesystem/model setup had to move off the guarded event loop.
limitations: Engineering validation does not establish answer quality or performance improvement. No real model answer was tested through Studio in this integration.
One question per thread; use a new thread after changing question, harness or source revision.
Agent Server owns checkpoints; external WorldStore is not transactionally rewound. Time travel and fork consistency are unsupported.
A synchronous provider call already in flight must finish or time out before cancellation can fully release its resources.
Restart the server after editing harness code in the parent directory.
Local development server must remain running. No cloud deployment or LangSmith tracing is configured.
